comment: The uptime and instant auto-scaling during our Black Friday peak surpassed expectations. Response time was under 10 minutes.
Zero-trust enforcement is seamless with hardware keys. We would appreciate more granular permission audits for junior developers.
Real-time dashboard renders large datasets with zero lag. Predictive forecasting helped optimize our inventory by 22%.
Strong compliance adherence, but the initial onboarding workflow took three weeks longer than promised due to credential verification.
Great regional server latency. Pricing is very competitive compared to legacy hyperscalers.
Documentation for custom SQL connectors was outdated. Customer support resolved it after 24 hours, but SLA specifies under 8 hours.
